# A matching Settings subcategory reveals the following section siblings

Settings search tracks whether a subcategory heading matched. Until the next subcategory, it searches following ordinary siblings for highlights and shows them regardless of their own match result. A new subcategory clears that inherited state. The frame-budget and stale-query guards remain. This ordered-sibling source fact has no new test assertion; the primary discussion has an explicit missing comment and gives zero full-audit credit.

Scope: preferences/search.
